subject: Additive genetic variance and environmental variance analysis

messages.author: 401513cc66250353
messages.subject: Additive genetic variance and environmental variance analysis
parts:
Hello, I was wondering if there are functions in r/qtl2 that can determine the additive genetic variance and the environmental variance of a dataset.  Any insight would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Additive genetic variance and environmental variance analysis
parts:
The function est_herit() will estimate the heritability using an estimated kinship matrix, but facilities for this purpose are limited in R/qtl2.

karl
